name: What types of angle stop valves are available, and which is best?

mainEntity.name: What types of angle stop valves are available, and which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several types of angle stop valves, including multi-turn (compression) and quarter-turn (ball or ceramic disc) valves. Quarter-turn valves are generally considered best due to their durability and ease of operation, requiring only a quarter turn to fully open or close. Multi-turn valves, while common in older homes, can seize up over time. A practical tradeoff to consider is the initial cost versus long-term reliability and ease of use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quarter-turn valves are generally best for durability and ease of use compared to older multi-turn valves. Consider initial cost versus long-term reliability.
